cards.meaning: to bypass or go around a set process; to skip over the proper procedure
cards.example: Labing-isa sa labinlimang kontrata ng GenCorp ay lumampas sa bidding process.
cards.exampleMeaning: 11 of GenCorp's 15 contracts bypassed the bidding process.
cards.note: Mas neutral at pormal ang dating ng 'paglampas' kumpara sa mas kolokyal na 'linusutan,' na may bahid na ng intensyon na talagang linlangin. Karaniwang gamit sa balita/gobyerno: lumampas sa proseso, nilampasan ang bidding, lampas sa itinakdang batas.
cards.tiesTo: 11 of 15 GenCorp Industries contracts with Davao City Hall (P34.2M) routed around public bidding as negotiated, small-value procurement

cards.meaning: secret; hidden, done without public knowledge
cards.example: Lihim na kasunduan ang tawag sa kontratang ginawa nang hindi bukas sa publiko.
cards.exampleMeaning: A contract made without being open to the public is called a secret agreement.
cards.note: Madalas gamitin sa pang-araw-araw na usapan ('may lihim siyang plano'), pero sa konteksto ng gobyerno mas mabigat ang kahulugan — nangangahulugan ito ng kakulangan sa transparency. Karaniwang pares: lihim na kasunduan, lihim na deal, itinago nang lihim.
cards.tiesTo: GenCorp/Davao City Hall contracts processed outside open public bidding

cards.meaning: to rebound, pick back up — a gradual, steady recovery from a low point
cards.example: 尽管消费依然疲软，工业利润已经开始回升。
cards.examplePinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiāofèi yīrán píruǎn, gōngyè lìrùn yǐjīng kāishǐ huíshēng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Despite consumption remaining weak, industrial profits have already started to rebound.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register, standard in economic reporting (PPI, industrial profit, GDP). Near-synonym contrast: 反弹 (fǎntán, 'bounce/rebound') is more 口语/colloquial and implies something sharp or sudden, like a ball bouncing; 回升 is slower and steadier, a gradual climb back. Collocations: 利润回升、价格回升、经济回升.
cards.tiesTo: China's PPI turning positive (+3.8% y/y) after nearly 3 years of factory-gate deflation

cards.meaning: to bottom out — reach the exact low point of a decline before it turns
cards.example: 工厂出厂价格三年来首次触底回升。
cards.examplePinyin: Gōngchǎng chūchǎng jiàgé sānnián lái shǒucì chùdǐ huíshēng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Factory-gate prices bottomed out and rebounded for the first time in 3 years.
cards.note: 书面语/formal, precise economic/market-cycle term — marks the specific turning moment. Near-synonym contrast: 见底 (jiàndǐ, also 'bottom out') is more general-purpose, used for anything reaching its lowest point (even a river running dry); 触底 is specifically about economic or market cycles. Collocations: 触底反弹、触底回升、市场触底.
cards.tiesTo: China industrial-profit/PPI data marking the end of the factory-gate deflation stretch
